title: AIDID third-party registry snapshot
description: The shape of https://aidid.im/registry.json (and of its source snapshot `data/rp-registry.json`). Phase 0 is a build-time snapshot maintained by the AIDID project; phase 1 replaces it with a read of the on-chain registry. `origin` is proven with a `/.well-known/aidid-rp.txt` challenge — a declaration, not a trust signal.

updatedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD date of the snapshot (not a timestamp).

origin.description: Canonical https origin: scheme + host (+ port), no path, no trailing slash, no query/hash/credentials.

homepage.description: Public homepage for display only — not a trust signal.

did.description: The RP's own did:msg. Recommended today, required from phase 1 on.

capabilities.description: Declared integrations. Display-only: never a security guarantee.

tier.description: Ecosystem tier. Optional; when absent it is derived from `official` (`official: true` means `first-party`, otherwise `community`). Display-only: it says who maintains the entry, never how safe the site is.

challenge.description: Random token the RP must serve at /.well-known/aidid-rp.txt (with or without a trailing newline).

official.description: Maintained by the AIDID project itself.

x-aidid.honestLimit: Phase 0 is a repository snapshot. The on-chain RP registry (phase 1) is not deployed; `scripts/verify-rp-registry.mjs` checks each origin's /.well-known challenge in CI.
